title: The Manifold-Index Model: provably and efficiently avoiding the statistical and computational curse of dimensionality
abstract: arXiv:2611.20275v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study vector-valued regression with predictors filling a tube around an unknown $m$-dimensional manifold $\mathcal{M}$ in $\mathbb{R}^D$. In the Manifold-Index Model, the mean response is $F=f\circ\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$, where $\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$ is the nearest-point projection onto $\mathcal{M}$ and $f:\mathcal{M}\to\mathbb{R}^p$ is a possibly non-injective link function. Multiscale ANisotropic lOcal Regression (MANOR) estimates tangent planes by multiscale PCA of predictors with similar responses, then refines them by pooling outer products of local slopes. The neighborhoods narrow tangentially while retaining complete normal fibers. We assume a Lipschitz link differential and bounded response noise. For $p\ge m$, under our geometric and sampling conditions, $n$ independent observations give mean tangent-space error of order $n^{-2/(m+4)}$ and integrated squared prediction error at the $m$-dimensional nonparametric rate $n^{-4/(m+4)}$

translated_title: 流形指数模型：可证明且高效地避免统计与计算上的维数灾难
translated_abstract: 我们研究预测变量分布在 $\mathbb{R}^D$ 中未知 $m$ 维流形 $\mathcal{M}$ 周围管状区域内的向量值回归问题。在流形指数模型中，平均响应为 $F=f\circ\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$，其中 $\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$ 是到流形 $\mathcal{M}$ 的最近点投影，$f:\mathcal{M}\to\mathbb{R}^p$ 是一个可能非单射的连接函数。多尺度各向异性局部回归（MANOR）通过对具有相似响应的预测变量进行多尺度主成分分析（PCA）来估计切平面，然后通过汇集局部斜率的外积对其进行精细化，使邻域沿切向收缩的同时保留完整的法向纤维。我们假设连接函数的微分满足 Lipschitz 条件且响应噪声有界。当 $p\ge m$ 时，在我们的几何与采样条件下，$n$ 个独立观测可给出 $n^{-2/(m+4)}$ 阶的平均切空间误差，以及达到 $m$ 维非参数速率 $n^{-4/(m+4)}$ 的积分平方预测误差。
tldr: 提出流形指数模型及MANOR算法，通过对相似响应的预测变量进行多尺度PCA估计切平面，使预测误差达到仅依赖流形内在维度 $m$ 的最优非参数速率 $n^{-4/(m+4)}$，可证明地克服了环境维度带来的维数灾难。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Manifold-Index Model and the MANOR algorithm, which estimates tangent planes via multiscale PCA of predictors with similar responses, achieving the $m$-dimensional nonparametric rate $n^{-4/(m+4)}$ and provably avoiding the curse of dimensionality.
